          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'

        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: separators are stripped, a leading '+'
            keeps the supplied country code otherwise '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped, and the result must carry 8 to 15
            digits after the '+'. For example '0412 345 678' is stored and
            returned as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '0412345678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-30'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address (i.e. they share a household).
            Optional and write-only; defaults to false.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier assigned when the owner joins a
                household (created with 'sharesHousehold' true against an
                existing owner who has the same last name and address). All
                owners in the same household share this value. Null when the
                owner does not belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true

## Summary

The task: normalize an owner's `address` on create (trim & collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand `ST→STREET`, `RD→ROAD`, `AVE→AVENUE`), store/return the normalized form, reject a blank-after-normalization address, and use the normalized form in all address comparisons.

### Changes

1. **New `AddressNormalizer`** (`rest/validation/AddressNormalizer.java`) — mirrors the existing `TelephoneNormalizer` style. Trims, collapses internal whitespace, upper-cases, then expands the abbreviations token-by-token. Returns `null` for `null`, `""` for blank input.

2. **`OwnerMapper`** — added a `@Mapping(target = "address", ... qualifiedByName = "normalizeAddress")` on `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` (the create path, exactly parallel to how telephone is normalized). This makes the stored and returned address normalized. The update path (which uses setters, not this mapper) is intentionally untouched, since normalization applies only on create.

3. **`ClinicServiceImpl`** — household duplicate detection (`findHouseholdMembers`) and the shared household id seed (`generateHouseholdId`) now normalize the address via a new `normalizeHouseholdAddress` helper (built on `AddressNormalizer`), applied to *both* sides of every comparison. This keeps household matching/id correct even against addresses stored in a non-normalized form (e.g. legacy/seed data), fully satisfying "every comparison of addresses must use the normalized form."

### Required-field check
A blank-after-normalization address (e.g. `"   "`) is rejected with `400`, as the test confirms (validation error on the `address` field).

### Tests
`./mvnw -o test` → `Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — `BUILD SUCCESS`:
- `coreNormalizesWhitespaceAndCase`: `"  12  main  st "` → `"12 MAIN STREET"` ✓
- `functionalityExpandsAbbreviations`: `"7 elm ave"` → `"7 ELM AVENUE"` ✓
- `errorRejectsBlankAfterNormalize`: `"   "` → `400 Bad Request` ✓
